column1: # p209 - first-hand verification of the NO-MASKED class (the 152/179 census rows the p205-p208 comparator cannot see by construction)
# sample frame: masked rows ranked by number of occurrences in compose/patterns.md (client-facing recipes), top 10 taken
# channel: WebFetch on github.com (the only host that resolves here); curl CONNECT returns 403 for EVERY host, github.com included
# RESULT: 10/10 grant families correct. Point estimate of the masked-class error rate 0%; 95% upper bound ~26% (rule of three, n=10).
# The sample is deliberately NOT random: it is the highest-exposure subset, where p208's one true positive (towardsai/ai-tutor-app) lived.
# SIDE FINDING: GitHub does not classify OpenOLAT's LICENSE at all (sidebar shows an unnamed "License" link) although the blob is a verbatim
# Apache License 2.0. Any future audit keyed on the sidebar/API licence field would report a FALSE UNGRANTED on a correct cell.
